risk_search_after_pre2024_pass.selection: maximum 24bp geometric daily growth among no-liquidation paths with positive top-10%-winner-removed return and positive H1 and H2; tie-break by lower drawdown

data.source: official Bybit public MT4 hourly archives plus actual Bybit funding when available; incomplete funding uses adverse reserve
data.source_gap_rule: retain expected hourly grid, reset all rolling state at a gap, prohibit labels across gaps, and charge an open account position its causal structural stop plus exit cost at the boundary

evaluation.conditional_development: calendar 2023, opened only after every 2022H2 confirmation gate passes
evaluation.official_sequential_replay: 2024H1 only: 2024-01-01 through 2024-06-30 with the frozen model and risk configuration fixed from information through 2023-12-31, opened immediately after every 2023 gate passes

official_half_year_contract.later_half_years: A later strategy version may use only information available before that half-year. An already observed period is not relabeled independent OOS for the revised version.

evaluation.training: 2021-10-01 through 2022-03-31; event labels must resolve before 2022-04-01

features: signed breakout distance divided by ATR20
signed distance from opposite 96h channel in ATR units
last available funding rate and 30-day funding z-score

2022H2_confirmation_all_required: at least 80 resolved events and 30 completed filtered account trades
prediction Spearman above 0.05 and positive RMSE skill versus the train-mean baseline
24bp filtered total return and geometric daily growth positive
24bp filtered geometric daily growth strictly above the matched all-breakout baseline
24bp median completed trade positive and profit factor above 1
2023_development_all_required: base 24bp path positive with positive median, PF above 1 and positive winner-removal replay
base 24bp daily growth above the fixed 0.07001887213879954% current-rank benchmark
2024H1_reporting: evaluate the frozen pre-2024 version immediately after every 2023 gate passes
record full-calendar 24bp growth, total return, median, PF, MDD, winner removal, month breadth, liquidation and unresolved positions
do not open 2024H2 or later data inside this strategy version

model.calibration: one non-negative scalar fit only on the calibration partition
model.decision_rule: take the structural breakout only when calibrated predicted 24bp net notional return is strictly positive; otherwise flat
model.target: realized structural-trade notional return after the fixed 24bp round-trip cost and causal funding treatment

structure.entry: first hourly open after a completed close outside the prior completed 96-hour Donchian channel
structure.exit: first hourly open after a completed close through the opposite prior completed 48-hour Donchian exit channel
structure.stop: 2.0 times completed ATR20 from the entry; adverse opening gaps fill at the opening price
